tp_uic_contribution.decision: Detection-aware selection chose TP-UIC full in 24/24 cases, but at +30 dB its AUC equalled plain LS and no-IC (0.611); perfect-channel reached 0.833.
tp_uic_contribution.allowed_claim: TP-UIC is an optional engineering preprocessor with corrected residual covariance.
tp_uic_contribution.forbidden_claim: TP-UIC provides an independent weak-target detection contribution.

association_over_sinr.independence_audit: Each split contains only 3 independent scenes with 2 noise realizations per scene.
association_over_sinr.decision: The robust correlation-aware method did not exceed SINR Top-K; the small independent-scene count also prevents a definitive null result.
association_over_sinr.allowed_claim: Association remains an unproven research hypothesis.

communication_system.decision: Do not build or run the complete communication model or system-level experiment until both upstream gates pass on independent evidence.

next_allowed_work: Treat TP-UIC as fixed preprocessing, not a claimed contribution.
If association is revisited, freeze its rule and minimum effect before collecting larger independent train/calibration/test scene sets.
Do not tune communication or system variables to rescue either failed gate.
